glosses: To make indistinct or hazy, to obscure or dim.

examples.text: to blur a photograph (by moving the camera while taking it)
to blur a manuscript (by handling it while damp)

glosses: To cause imperfection of vision in; to dim; to darken.

examples.text: His eyes are blurred with the lightning's glare.

glosses: To sully; to stain; to blemish, as reputation.

examples.text: Sarcasms may eclipse thine own, / But cannot blur my lost renown.

glosses: To transfer the input focus away from.

examples.text: Then give this box focus to blur the first one: […]

glosses: To use a sign, image, expression, etc. sufficiently close to a trademarked one that it causes confusion between them.
